name: Club and Spear
body:
In your hands, a club or spear is a much more dangerous weapon.

Prerequisite: Mahrog, Proficient with weapon, Str 15

Benefit: Increase the amount of damage dealt by a club, greatclub, shortspear, longspear, and spear by one step (for example, 1d6 becomes 1d8) to a maximum of 1d8 (2d6 if the weapon is two-handed).

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
